observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment && echo "=== FINAL VERIFICATION EVIDENCE ===" && CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev) && C() { docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve "$1:443:$CADDY_IP" "${@:2}"; } && echo "app.localhost/login => $(C app.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://app.localhost/login)" && echo "api.localhost/api/v1/ => $(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/)" && echo "api schema => $(C api.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/schema/)" && echo "admin login => $(C admin.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://admin.localhost/admin/login/)" && echo "tiles health => $(C tiles.localhost -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://tiles.localhost/health)" && echo "jwt login => $(C api.localhost -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-CSRFToken: x' -H 'Referer: https://api.localhost/' -d '{\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"AdminLocalPassw0rd!\"}' -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/)"
